WOODWORK — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #6
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: WOODWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Timber Defects, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Timber Defects.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Timber Defects.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Timber Defects.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Timber Defects.

2. When learning Woodworking Machines, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Woodworking Machines.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Woodworking Machines.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Woodworking Machines.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Woodworking Machines.

3. When learning Portable Power Tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Portable Power Tools.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Portable Power Tools.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Portable Power Tools.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Portable Power Tools.

4. When learning Health and Safety in the Workshop, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Health and Safety in the Workshop.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Health and Safety in the Workshop.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Health and Safety in the Workshop.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Health and Safety in the Workshop.

5. When learning Orthographic Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Orthographic Drawing.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Orthographic Drawing.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Orthographic Drawing.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Orthographic Drawing.

6. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Ignore burnt cables

7. When learning Project activity, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project activity.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Project activity.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project activity.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project activity.

8. When learning Finishing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Finishing.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Finishing.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Finishing.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Finishing.

9. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. Monitor
   C. CPU
   D. Keyboard

10. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

11. When learning Manufactured boards, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Manufactured boards.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Manufactured boards.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Manufactured boards.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Manufactured boards.

12. When learning Detailed drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Detailed drawing.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Detailed drawing.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Detailed drawing.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Detailed drawing.

13. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. Input Cable Tester

14. When learning Trends in woodwork, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Trends in woodwork.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Trends in woodwork.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Trends in woodwork.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Trends in woodwork.

15. When learning Mass Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Mass Production.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Mass Production.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Mass Production.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Mass Production.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Manufactured boards and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Mass Production and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Finishing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Project activity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Orthographic Drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Detailed drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Trends in woodwork and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Health and Safety in the Workshop and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Portable Power Tools and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Woodworking Machines and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
